messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: High error rate from Willow Corp (private VPC) to /v1/infer. Paging oncall mira (primary).
mira: on it. grabbing initial logs. can someone confirm if this is only Willow's dedicated pool or wider?
willow-ops: seeing 401/handshake failures since 09:12 UTC. nothing else changed on our side. requests started failing after their nightly cert rotation.
mira: thanks. tailing gateway logs now. past minute shows a lot of TLS alert messages and `bad certificate` from the auth proxy.
mira: snippet from gateway:
```
2026-03-15T09:13:01Z auth-proxy[pid=42]: TLS alert 40 (handshake failure) - client cert verify failed: certificate has expired
2026-03-15T09:13:02Z auth-proxy[pid=42]: TLS alert 40 - no shared cipher
```
rafa: I can jump in for packet capture if needed. but first - is this mTLS mutual auth for Willow? or are they using our tenant auth proxy with client cert pinning?
willow-ops: we use the VPC private bridge with mTLS. our PKI rotated the client certs at 09:05 UTC.
mira: ok. early hypothesis: Willow's cert rotation produced a cert chain incompatible with Redwood's accepted client CA list (maybe missing intermediate or EKU mismatch).
jamie: adding a note: this only impacts their Dedicated pool (d-pool-willow-1). No cross-tenant impact observed. good containment.
mira: mitigation options: 1) ask Willow to roll back to previous client certs, 2) temporarily accept new intermediate on Redwood bridge (requires eng change), 3) add a per-tenant override to skip strict EKU check (fast but risky).
liam: @mira what's the customer appetite? they said they can roll back but will take ~20-30m.
willow-ops: rollback in progress. ETA ~25m. can you accept a short maintenance window? we need traffic unblocked asap.
mira: while rollback completes, can we put a short retry/backoff in the auth proxy so in-flight jobs don't all fail immediately? jamie / rafa any quick config that can soften failures?
rafa: we can increase connection retries and extend TLS handshake timeout to 10s, but if cert validation fails, retries won't help. We can enable `allow_client_ca_update=true` on the bridge which will accept the presented chain if it validates against tenant override store — requires a config flip on the private control plane (will need infra sign-off).
jamie: infra oncall? @devops-bot do we have permissions to flip per-tenant CA override in prod for dedicated pools?
devops-bot: @jamie Confirmed: per-tenant CA override endpoint exists at /internal/tenants/{id}/ca-override. Requires ops sudo and 2-person approval. Audit log created when toggled.
mira: let's do conservative approach: wait for Willow rollback (~25m). if they can't complete, we'll do per-tenant override as fallback. @liam please coordinate with Willow and update status every 10m.
willow-ops: rollback started. doing smoke tests now — will post results in 5m.
mira: running validation checklist: 1) auth-proxy logs for successful handshake, 2) sample request from Willow to /v1/infer returns 200, 3) check client cert chain in logs for correct KID and EKU.
rafa: if rollback fails, here's a quick test command Willow can run to show the cert chain to us:
```
openssl s_client -connect bridge.redwood.internal:443 -cert client.pem -key client.key -showcerts
```
please paste output.
willow-ops: smoke tests: 3/3 success for auth handshake now. one long-inflight job still failing but new requests are working. thanks!
mira: great. continue monitoring. I'll keep the thread active for handoff in 30m.
jamie: filing incident ticket and flagging for postmortem: `INC-2329999999` (Willow mTLS cert rotation - temporary rollback). assign to eng-runtime and private infra.
liam: will coordinate timeline and customer RCA meeting. willow-ops, can you confirm cause when rollback fully completes?
willow-ops: yes. preliminary: our rotation tooling issued certs signed by a new intermediate that we hadn't uploaded to the tenant CA store. rollout automation should have included that step but missed due to a deploy race. we'll capture logs and share.
mira: ok. next steps for us: 1) wait 30m monitoring window 2) if errors resurface, escalate to per-tenant CA override with 2-person ops approval 3) postmortem to include playbook updates (ensure rotation includes intermediate push). assign owners: jamie (postmortem), rafa (mitigation script), liam (customer comms).
devops-bot: reminder: please run the post-incident checklist after incident close: /scripts/incidents/checklist --id INC-2329999999
mira: handing off to night oncall jamie at 09:50 UTC. jamie please ack when you take ownership.
jamie: ack. monitoring dashboards pinned. setting alert suppression for Willow spurious errors for next 40m.
willow-ops: all clear from our side. we'll keep you posted if rollback causes any downstream issues. thanks for quick response team :thumbsup:
mira: thanks everyone. leaving channel. if anything pops, please re-ping with `!pager`.
jamie: closing incident if no regressions by 10:20 UTC. will open postmortem ticket and invite Willow to RCA meeting.
